newsitem.title: USA: Westco Bancorp returns on assets rise.
newsitem.headline: Westco Bancorp returns on assets rise.

text.p: Westco Bancorp Inc, reporting improved fourth-quarter earnings, said returns on average assets during the fourth quarter were 1.49 percent and average equity was 9.66 percent, compared to 7.64 percent in the same 1995 period.

But the parent of First Federal Savings Association of Westchester posted a 21.1 percent decrease in full-year results due to the special $1.6 million Federal Deposit Insurance Corp assessment that was partly offset by increases of $28,000 in net interest income and $18,000 in non-interest income, a decrease of $69,000 in other non-interest expenses and a $606,000 decrease in income taxes.
For the quarter, it earned $0.41 a diluted share, up from $0.31. For the full year, it earned $1.16 a diluted share, down from $1.42 a year earlier.
